entries.what: Slept in on the holiday, then walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk with Iris, who had the day off for Indigenous Peoples' Day, before a coffee run.
entries.outcome: Easy morning before the overtime swing; planks still dry.

entries.what: Worked the 1 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. swing in the IT cage at RF-4, clearing frozen handhelds as peak overtime kept the scanners busy.
entries.outcome: Cage down to about two dozen scanners by close.

entries.what: Got home near midnight, ate leftover rice bowl and did 20 minutes of subnetting in the practice app.
Slept until 9, fixed her parents' printer remotely over a quick call, then drove to Ruel Road, gas first at the station.
Trained Bao on scanner trigger boards from 3 to 5, then a director email arrived demanding a root cause for dead batteries by end of day; she vented to her assistant and had her reply made less rude.
entries.outcome: Sent a polite reply blaming a bad battery lot and aging packs.

entries.what: Late shift stretched on with a red-beep night as scanners failed and pickers fell behind rate; Carla texted her about dead units.
Midterm week crowds everywhere; Noemi spent her late morning on the cert practice questions at home, weak on port numbers.
Swing shift in the cage, logging tickets and updating the RMA sheet for scanners headed back to the vendor.
entries.outcome: Sheet current; Victor stopped by with a vague request.

entries.what: Late dinner at home with Iris, who talked about the shared budget sheet.
Slept in, then Thursday sushi night prep with Iris; Iris ordered as usual.
entries.outcome: Sushi arrived for dinner after Noemi's shift ended late, eaten cold.

entries.what: Trained Bao 3 to 5 on the repair bench; word spread that Greg's last day was tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Bao managed a trigger board solo.

entries.what: Greg handed her a short list of vendor tickets and passwords for the RMA portal at the end of the evening.
entries.outcome: She copied the list into her notes.

entries.what: Greg's last day; Rhonda's team announced Victor as acting IT desk lead, and Noemi absorbed Greg's vendor tickets, scanner RMAs and scheduling on the spot.
entries.outcome: She now covers the lead duties without the title.

entries.what: Told her assistant Victor 'got the loot drop' and asked for help drafting a congrats message to him.
Picked up Taquería Colima for her Friday shift meal and ate it in the cage while building the new schedule.
Walked the marsh boardwalk in the morning, then coffee with Iris.
Worked her alternating Saturday at RF-4 handling scanner repairs and the new vendor ticket queue.
Late night at home on her desktop, unwinding with a gaming session.
Slept late, then did two hours of subnetting drills with the study guide.
entries.outcome: Got a little better on port numbers.

entries.what: Helped her brother Mateo plan parts for his first PC at her parents' fourplex.
Sunday night co-op survival game with her online squad as packetloss_.
